The problem

Building SaaS from scratch is broken

You have a great idea. But before you can build it, you need to solve the same problems everyone else does.

Wasting hours on boilerplate

Setting up auth, payments, and infrastructure from scratch every single time. Days lost before writing a single line of business logic.

Fragile integrations that break

Stitching together auth providers, payment APIs, and databases with duct tape. One update and the whole thing crumbles.

Losing money to slow launches

Every week you spend building infrastructure is a week you're not shipping features. Your competitors are already live.

The solution

Everything you need to ship fast

Stop rebuilding the wheel. Start with a foundation that works.

Launch in days, not months

Pre-built auth, payments, and dashboard. Clone, configure, and deploy — your SaaS is live before the week is out.

Production-ready security

Row Level Security, server-side auth, encrypted secrets, and Stripe webhook verification — all baked in from day one.

One config, infinite apps

Change your app name, pricing, and copy in a single config file. The same template powers every app you build.
